MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The assorted heat shrink tubing and rubber grommets fit my earlier crimp connector purchase because they help insulate connections and protect wires from rubbing against holes.",
    "The hook and loop strips and small epoxy pack fit my repair interests: they offer removable fastening or a firm bond alongside the duct tape and vinyl cement I have used."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Locking nuts and a digital caliper could be useful, but I have no current bolt assembly or precision measuring task that makes either a natural next purchase.",
    "The temperature controller assumes a brewing or enclosure project I have not indicated, while the single large heat shrink diameter requires a specific cable size I do not currently need.",
    "Twelve tubes of super glue feel excessive for my occasional repairs. The marine heat shrink kit is relevant, but I would choose the assorted sizes and colors this time."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My purchases of clamps and wiring supplies seem to have been taken as interest in almost any workshop hardware, even when its purpose does not connect to a task I have shown.",
    "My adhesive purchases seem to have been treated as a reason to offer more glue without enough attention to the type of bond or quantity I would actually use."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "For wiring supplies, useful size options matter to me more than a specialized product whose dimensions may not fit my repair.",
    "I choose supplies for particular jobs rather than simply stocking up on tools. A recommendation feels stronger when I can see how it complements something I already use.",
    "Quantity depends on the job: my earlier bulk tape purchase does not mean I want a large pack of every adhesive."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations understood my interest in practical repairs and wiring, but sometimes stretched that into unrelated tools or supplies without a clear current use."
}
